sensitivity.note: Sensitivity, not timing qualification: fixed +/-4 source-frame interval, 81 samples, both NLERP and SLERP, all 21 duplicate local rotations and separately the five directly weighted identities. No duplicate used to select time.

mesh_coverage.note: Coverage is native vertex data, not proof every LOD/mesh was drawn. No procedural or bind correction fitted or applied.

controls.note: Palette-only evidence: unparented controls are not weighted to the verified Innerwear body mesh. Parent by the later LMT root for this hypothesis; no position fit. Identical/nearly identical candidates cannot discriminate selection.

limitations: Times/entries are numerical fits from nonduplicate bones, not authoritative runtime counters.
NLERP/SLERP alternatives are diagnostic; engine interpolation and compression are not independently qualified.
Only five of the 21 duplicate local rotation identities affect the verified body mesh; other identities are palette-only evidence.
